_comment: Dangerous identifier and member-pattern list; host changes take effect after a service restart and are not hot-reloaded through an API.

identifiers.constructor: Dynamic code generation through constructor is forbidden
identifiers.exports: exports is forbidden (CommonJS module/exports are disabled)
identifiers.module: module is forbidden (CommonJS module/exports are disabled)

process.env: Reading server environment variables is forbidden; pass third-party credentials through input
